content: We have carbon NMR data: chemical shifts list. Need number of methyl groups (CH3). Methyl carbons appear around 10-30 ppm for aliphatic, also maybe 20-30. In list we have 26.40, 36.40 (two same), 58.70, plus aromatic carbons 124-168. So likely methyl is 26.40 ppm. Also 36.40 could be methylene or tertiary carbon. 58.70 likely O-CH3 (methoxy) maybe also methyl attached to heteroatom. That is also a methyl carbon. So there may be two methyl groups: one at 26.4 (alkyl) and one at 58.7 (O-CH3). Need to confirm via HSQC or proton NMR. Let's get HSQC to see which carbons have attached protons.
